texts.zh:
随着越来越多的太空文明彼此间建立了正式的关系，星系之中愈发生机盎然。为了避免国家间出现悲剧性的误解，越来越多的外交人士呼吁设立一个新的泛星系组织——如果愿意的话也可以称为共同体，在那里星系中的各帝国可以召开会议，共商星系大事。

[Root.GetName]应该承诺支持星海共同体的创立吗？
texts.en:
As more and more spacefaring civilizations establish formal relations with one another, the galaxy is becoming a vibrant and lively place. To avoid tragic misunderstandings between nations, an increasing number of diplomats have called for the establishment of a new pan-galactic organization - a community, if you will, where the empires of the galaxy can meet to discuss important matters.

Should the [Root.GetName] pledge its support for the creation of the Galactic Community?

texts.zh: 让我们再试一次。我们应该组建星海共同体吗？
texts.en: Let's try again. Should we form a Galactic Community?

label.zh: 是的，值得进行这样的尝试。
label.en: Yes, this is a worthy endeavor.

tooltips.zh: 我们将支持建立星海共同体。
tooltips.en: We will support the creation of the Galactic Community.

label.zh: 不，我们没时间做这种毫无意义的事情。
label.en: No, we have no time for this nonsense.

tooltips.zh: 我们将不支持建立星海共同体。
tooltips.en: We will not support the creation of the Galactic Community.

title.en: The Birth of the Galactic Community

texts.zh:
这是历史性的一天。星系中数个重要的太空帝国，包括[Root.GetName]，宣布了星海共同体的创立。这一国家间组织会作为一个论坛，整个星系的事务都可以在此讨论和决定。

作为其创始成员国之一，我们可以为星系历史的这一里程碑感到骄傲。
texts.en:
This is a historic day. Several of the galaxy's prominent spacefaring empires, including the [Root.GetName], have announced the creation of the Galactic Community. This supranational organization will serve as a forum where matters involving the entire galaxy can be discussed and decided upon.

As one of its founding members, we can take pride in this milestone of galactic history.

label.zh: 全星系伟大的一天！
label.en: A great day for the galaxy!

label.zh: 首个银河议会成立时（on_galactic_council_established → 隐藏50，5天后）
label.en: When the first Galactic Council is established (on_galactic_council_established -> hidden 50, 5 days later)

texts.zh:
星海共同体的各个成员国已经投票决定设立星系理事会。这一受人尊敬的实体只允许社群中三个实力最强、最具影响力的帝国成为其成员。到下一轮议会被选出为止，这三个国家将是[council_member_1.GetName]，[council_member_2.GetName]和[council_member_3.GetName]。

共同体期望理事会成员国可以领导和保卫整个星海共同体。他们获得了提权，可以跳过那些时常在大型政治机构中阻碍决策流程的繁文缛节。
texts.en:
The members of the Galactic Community have voted to establish a Galactic Council. Membership in this august body will be limited to representatives from the three most powerful and influential empires in the Community. Until a new Council is elected, these are the [council_member_1.GetName], the [council_member_2.GetName], and the [council_member_3.GetName].

The members of the Council are expected to lead and safeguard the Galactic Community. Their increased powers allow them to cut through some of the red tape that so often inhibits the decision-making process in large political institutions.

label.zh: 希望他们有能力完成任务……
label.en: Hopefully they are up to the task...

label.zh: 现在我们终于可以大有作为了！
label.en: Now we can finally get things done!

label.zh: 啊，看来那些幕后操纵者总算露出了真容！
label.en: Ah, so the puppeteers finally reveal themselves!

title.en: The Birth of the Galactic Community

texts.zh:
尽管我们决定不为建立某种国家间星系机构提供帮助，若干其他帝国已经联合创立了这种东西。在他们“历史性的”联合声明中，他们向全星系宣布了星海共同体的创立。这一组织的目的是作为一个论坛，会影响星系整体的重要事务可以在那里讨论。

由于我们拒绝参与这一星海共同体的创立，[Root.GetName]将不被算作成员国。
texts.en:
Despite our decision not to lend our support behind the founding of some sort of supranational galactic institution, several other empires have banded together to create just such a thing. In their "historic" joint announcement, they declared the creation of the Galactic Community to the galaxy. This organization is to serve as a forum where important matters that affect the galaxy as a whole can be discussed.

As we refused to take part in the creation of this Galactic Community, the [Root.GetName] is not yet considered a member.

label.zh: 那些傲慢的蠢货。
label.en: Those arrogant fools.

title.en: The Birth of the Galactic Community

texts.zh:
数个太空帝国，其中一些我们尚不清楚，已经联合组建了一个“星海共同体”。这一国家间机构的目的是作为一个论坛，在那里可以共商重要事务。

虽然我们并不曾参与其建立，那些成员国已经向[Root.GetName]发出了邀请，请求我们成为正式的成员国。我们应该接受邀请吗？
texts.en:
Several spacefaring empires, some of them unknown to us, have banded together to form a "Galactic Community." This supranational institution is to serve as a forum where important matters can be discussed.

Although we were not involved in its founding, the other members have extended an invitation to the [Root.GetName] for formal membership. Should we accept?

label.zh: 好的，让我们加入这一组织。
label.en: Yes, let us join this community.

label.zh: 不，我们不会参与这种事。
label.en: No, we will take no part in this.

label.zh: 外星渣滓。
label.en: Xeno scum.

label.zh: 种族洁癖
label.en: Fanatic Purifiers

label.zh: 星球将燃烧……
label.en: Worlds will burn...

label.zh: 炙热星球先驱
label.en: Scorched World Heralds

label.zh: 纵火本能
label.en: Pyromanic Instinct

label.zh: 我们不关心什么“共同体”
label.en: We do not care for this "Community."

label.zh: 不久后他们也将臣服于我们的大可汗。
label.en: Soon they too will bow to our great Khan.

label.zh: 可汗后裔
label.en: Heirs of the Khan

label.zh: 可怜的有机生物。
label.en: Pitiful organics.

label.zh: 铁心灭绝者
label.en: Determined Exterminator

label.zh: 他们将被吞噬。
label.en: THEY WILL BE DEVOURED.

label.zh: 噬杀蜂群
label.en: Devouring Swarm

label.zh: 否
label.en: No

texts.zh: 组建一个超国家的“星海共同体”的提议已经失败。并没有足够的帝国承诺会支持这种机构的创立。
texts.en: The initiative to form a supranational "Galactic Community" has failed. Not enough empires pledged their support to the creation of such an institution.

label.zh: 那些蠢货还没准备好。
label.en: The other fools were not ready.

label.zh: 总算甩掉麻烦了！
label.en: Good riddance!

summary.text:
# 星海共同体 / A Galactic Community

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/galactic_community_events.txt:14-340,458-608`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:247,299,4400`

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 每年脉冲 galcom.1（隐藏）：银河社群未成立且未开始，至少3个非灭绝国家，且有一个非灭绝非格式塔国家与70%以上的可玩国家有通信。
  Yearly pulse galcom.1 (hidden): the Galactic Community is neither founded nor begun, at least 3 non-homicidal countries exist and one non-homicidal, non-gestalt country is in contact with 70%+ of playable countries.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 2「银河社群」：向相互通信的国家提议成立；选项设赞成（galcom_form_aye）或反对（galcom_form_nay）。
  2 "A Galactic Community": the proposal goes to all countries in contact; options set aye (galcom_form_aye) or nay (galcom_form_nay).
- 360天后 galcom.3 点票：≥3票赞成 → 赞成国入会并收到 5「银河社群的诞生」，反对国收到 6；20天后向其他潜在申请者发出邀请（galcom.15 → 16）；不足 → 10「银河社群无人支持」并在50年后（18000天）由 galcom.20 重试。
  360 days later galcom.3 tallies: 3+ aye -> aye countries join and get 5 "The Birth of the Galactic Community", nay countries 6; 20 days later invitations go to other potential applicants (galcom.15 -> 16); otherwise 10 "No Support for Galactic Community" and galcom.20 retries 50 years later (18000 days).
- 此后每十年（galcom.14）向尚未加入的国家再次发出 16 邀请；首个银河议会成立后 galcom.50（隐藏）→ 5天后 51「银河议会成立」。
  Afterwards every decade (galcom.14) 16 invites countries that have not joined; once the first Galactic Council exists galcom.50 (hidden) -> 51 "Formation of the Galactic Council" 5 days later.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 5 / 6 / 10 视玩家的表态与票数而定，互斥。
  5 / 6 / 10 depend on the player's vote and the count, and are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 16 的选项含继承汗国与太阳朋克的专属版本。
  16 has variants for the Heir of the Khan and Solarpunk.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：galcom.1/3/20 的条件、点票逻辑、重试周期、16 的来源。
  Checked: conditions of galcom.1/3/20, the tally logic, the retry period and sources of 16.
- 更正：galcom.14（十年脉冲）和 galcom.50（议会成立）原为单独故事，现并入。
  Correction: galcom.14 (decade pulse) and galcom.50 (council formed) were separate stories; merged.
